content:
**Mutant Hound Chops** are a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A cut of Mutant Hound Meat which has been cooked to make it safer to eat and improve its nutritional value. Consuming it will improve the melee damage that one can do.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Wood (4) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Mutant Hound Meat | | Mutant Hound Chops (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after having picked up Mutant Hound Meat for the first time.
